summary: Dependency resolved from mutable GitHub ref without commit SHA
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:Kelvdra/libsignal` — an off-registry source pinned to the repository's mutable HEAD with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever that repository currently contains and runs any lifecycle scripts in the fetched tree. Whoever controls the Kelvdra/libsignal GitHub repository controls arbitrary code executed on every installer's machine, independently of what is shipped in this package's own tarball. The static match on `ping` in lib/Utils/generics.js at line 393 is a liveness/keep-alive helper for the package's WebSocket connection, not an exfiltration primitive.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
